worldEpochs.label: 王城罗德尔（玛利喀斯前）

conditions.label: 王城仍为罗德尔
conditions.hint: 尚未击败玛利喀斯；目标仍存在于王城罗德尔。

conditions.label: 已激活黄金树大教堂赐福
conditions.hint: 从该赐福出发的路线需要玩家已经激活它。

conditions.label: 已击败蒙葛特
conditions.hint: 只有击败王座前的蒙葛特后，才能把艾尔登王座作为已激活赐福目标。

conditions.label: 已击败神皮双人组
conditions.hint: Dragon Temple Altar 是该 Boss 区域后的赐福状态。

conditions.label: 已击败双月骑士蕾拉娜
conditions.hint: 击败 Castle Ensis 主 Boss 后才能激活 Ensis Moongazing Grounds。

conditions.label: 已解锁蕾娜魔法塔传送门
conditions.hint: Ranni 任务推进到可以使用 Renna's Rise 传送门。

conditions.label: 已击败碎星拉塔恩
conditions.hint: 拉塔恩战后，宁姆格福才出现通往诺克隆的陨石坑入口。

conditions.label: 已完成仪典镇解谜
conditions.hint: 点亮仪典镇四座雕像后，通往圣树树冠的传送门开放。

conditions.label: 已进入火山官邸
conditions.hint: 已通过官邸入口或其他合法入口进入火山官邸内部。

conditions.label: 已击败神皮贵族
conditions.hint: 击败火山官邸神皮贵族后，Temple of Eiglay 赐福可激活。

conditions.label: 已击败圣树骑士罗蕾塔
conditions.hint: 击败圣树城入口 Boss 后，继续向圣树城区域推进。

conditions.label: Baleful Shadow defeated
conditions.hint: Conservative route state for the Ranni progression before the descent from Nokstella Waterfall Basin to Lake of Rot.

conditions.label: Astel defeated
conditions.hint: The route beyond the Astel arena is only available after the boss encounter is complete.

conditions.label: Dark Moon Ring route state
conditions.hint: The locked route from Astel's arena to Moonlight Altar is modeled conservatively with this Ranni quest state.

conditions.label: Valiant Gargoyles defeated
conditions.hint: The Deeproot coffin route is kept closed until the Siofra Aqueduct boss gate has been cleared.

conditions.label: Rold Medallion available
conditions.hint: The normal Grand Lift of Rold route requires the Rold Medallion progression state.

conditions.label: Haligtree Secret Medallion complete
conditions.hint: Both halves are treated as complete before opening the Consecrated Snowfield lift route.

conditions.label: Pureblood Knight's Medal available
conditions.hint: The direct Mohgwyn teleport origin is only usable after the medal has been obtained.

conditions.label: Commander Niall defeated
conditions.hint: Castle Sol's rooftop post-boss route is kept closed until Commander Niall is defeated.

conditions.label: Fire Giant defeated
conditions.hint: The Forge of the Giants post-boss grace is only a formal destination after the Fire Giant gate.

conditions.label: Mohg, Lord of Blood defeated
conditions.hint: The Cocoon of the Empyrean post-boss grace is kept closed before Mohg is defeated.

conditions.label: Margit, the Fell Omen defeated
conditions.hint: The normal Stormveil legacy-dungeon entry is kept closed until the Margit gate has been cleared.

conditions.label: Godrick the Grafted defeated
conditions.hint: The formal back exit from Stormveil to Lake-Facing Cliffs is modeled after Godrick.

conditions.label: Academy Glintstone Key available
conditions.hint: The Academy gate route is kept closed until an Academy Glintstone Key is available.

conditions.label: Red Wolf of Radagon defeated
conditions.hint: The Debate Parlor post-boss route is modeled after the Red Wolf encounter.

conditions.label: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon defeated
conditions.hint: The Raya Lucaria Grand Library post-boss state is kept behind Rennala.

conditions.label: Dectus Medallion complete
conditions.hint: Both halves of the Dectus Medallion are required for the Grand Lift of Dectus route.

conditions.label: Draconic Tree Sentinel defeated
conditions.hint: The formal capital-entry edge is kept closed until the outer-wall gate boss is defeated.

nodes.label: 大道旁露台
nodes.description: 王城赐福清单中的大道旁露台；Eldenpedia 路线指南将其描述为王城路线分叉点。

nodes.label: 巨龙石翼上行段
nodes.description: 从大道旁露台向高处前进的入口地标；这是路线语义节点，不是原始地图坐标。

nodes.label: 黄金树大教堂
nodes.description: 古兰桑克斯的雷电路线起点赐福；默认路线要求该赐福已激活。

nodes.label: 大教堂西侧出口
nodes.description: 离开黄金树大教堂并向电梯方向下行的出口节点。

nodes.label: 西侧电梯下端
nodes.description: 电梯下降后的路线节点；之后继续沿楼梯和栏杆方向前进。

nodes.label: 古兰桑克斯上方栏杆
nodes.description: 需要从栏杆处向下跳到小平台；该连接是单向跳落。

nodes.label: 巨矛下方平台
nodes.description: 从栏杆跳下后的中间落点，再跳到巨矛上。

nodes.label: 女王闺阁
nodes.description: 王城路线中位于黄金树大教堂之后的赐福；不把它与王座前 Boss 房混为一层。

nodes.label: 王座前蒙葛特 Boss 门
nodes.description: Boss 前的状态节点；到达这里不等于已激活艾尔登王座赐福。

nodes.label: 艾尔登王座
nodes.description: 击败蒙葛特后可激活的王座赐福；路线状态与 Boss 前的王座门严格分离。

nodes.label: 古兰桑克斯的雷电
nodes.description: 传奇武器目标。玛利喀斯改变王城为灰烬王城后，该目标不可获取。

nodes.label: 希芙拉河井底
nodes.description: 希芙拉河井下降到底部后激活的赐福。

nodes.label: 希芙拉河远端电梯
nodes.description: 从井底区域继续前进后使用的电梯；这是跨楼层连接节点。

nodes.label: 希芙拉河岸
nodes.description: 希芙拉河主河道的赐福；从井底通过远端电梯抵达。

nodes.label: 逐渐崩毁的兽墓深处
nodes.region: 逐渐崩毁的法姆·亚兹拉
nodes.description: 法姆·亚兹拉的垂直路线起点之一。

nodes.label: 龙教堂外部接近段
nodes.region: 逐渐崩毁的法姆·亚兹拉
nodes.description: 从兽墓深处向龙教堂前进的外部/楼层连接节点。

nodes.label: 龙教堂祭坛
nodes.region: 逐渐崩毁的法姆·亚兹拉
nodes.description: 神皮双人组区域后的赐福；Boss 前后状态严格分开。

nodes.label: 城前镇
nodes.description: Castle Ensis 的主要外部入口赐福。

nodes.label: 恩希斯城检查站
nodes.description: 进入 Castle Ensis 后的检查站赐福。

nodes.label: 城主房间
nodes.description: Castle Ensis 主 Boss 前的赐福，不等于蕾拉娜已击败。

nodes.label: 双月骑士蕾拉娜 Boss 门
nodes.description: 蕾拉娜 Boss 前的门节点；击败 Boss 后才能继续到达后方赐福。

nodes.label: 恩希斯赏月地
nodes.description: 击败蕾拉娜后开放的 Castle Ensis 后方赐福。

nodes.label: 蕾娜魔法塔传送门
nodes.description: Ranni 任务推进后开放的单向传送门。

nodes.label: 安瑟尔河主流
nodes.description: 蕾娜魔法塔传送门的目标赐福。

nodes.label: 星陨坑入口
nodes.description: 碎星拉塔恩战后出现的诺克隆入口；没有该状态时不能从此处进入。

nodes.label: 诺克隆，永恒之城
nodes.description: 星陨坑下降后的诺克隆入口赐福。

nodes.label: 仪典镇
nodes.description: 完成仪典镇 Evergaol 解谜后，通往圣树的传送门位于此处。

nodes.label: 圣树传送门
nodes.description: 仪典镇解谜完成后开启的单向传送门。

nodes.label: 圣树树冠
nodes.description: 从仪典镇圣树传送门抵达的树冠起点。

nodes.label: 圣树骑士罗蕾塔 Boss 门
nodes.description: 圣树树冠向圣树城推进时的 Boss 门节点。

nodes.label: 圣树城大舞台
nodes.description: 击败圣树骑士罗蕾塔后继续进入圣树城的赐福状态。

nodes.label: 火山官邸
nodes.description: 火山官邸内部入口赐福；从这里进入 Prison Town 路线。

nodes.label: 囚犯教堂
nodes.description: 火山官邸下方监牢城镇的关键路线赐福。

nodes.label: 神皮贵族 Boss 门
nodes.description: 从囚犯教堂穿过监牢城镇后到达的神皮贵族 Boss 门。

nodes.label: 艾格雷教堂
nodes.description: 击败神皮贵族后激活的 Temple of Eiglay 赐福。

nodes.label: 灰烬王城状态
nodes.description: 状态对照节点：古兰桑克斯的雷电不在该状态可获取。

nodes.label: Nokstella, Eternal City
nodes.description: Formal route node for the Nokstella city section; the catalog contains the underlying grace entry.

nodes.label: Nokstella Waterfall Basin
nodes.description: Vertical transition node below Nokstella, before the descent to Lake of Rot.

nodes.label: Lake of Rot Shoreside

nodes.label: Grand Cloister

nodes.label: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void

nodes.label: Moonlight Altar
nodes.description: Post-Astel destination reached through the locked Ranni route.

nodes.label: Siofra Aqueduct / Valiant Gargoyles
nodes.description: Aqueduct boss gate before the coffin transfer to Deeproot Depths.

nodes.label: Deeproot coffin
nodes.description: One-way coffin transition after the Valiant Gargoyles gate.

nodes.label: Deeproot Depths
nodes.description: Arrival node for the Deeproot coffin route.

nodes.label: Prince of Death's Throne
nodes.description: Upper-root route destination in Deeproot Depths.

nodes.label: Mohgwyn sending gate
nodes.description: Western Snowfield sending gate; it is a separate Mohgwyn entrance from the Ordina route.

nodes.label: Pureblood Knight's Medal
nodes.description: Virtual route origin representing use of the item; it does not pretend to be a physical floor coordinate.

nodes.label: Palace Approach Ledge-Road
nodes.description: The sending-gate arrival side of Mohgwyn Palace.

nodes.label: Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance
nodes.description: Common arrival grace for the Pureblood Medal route and intermediate Palace route.

nodes.label: Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint
nodes.description: Interior midpoint before the Mohg elevator and boss gate.

nodes.label: Mohg, Lord of Blood
nodes.description: Mohg boss gate reached from the midpoint elevator.

nodes.label: Cocoon of the Empyrean
nodes.description: Post-Mohg grace and Shadow of the Erdtree access landmark.

nodes.label: Grand Lift of Rold
nodes.description: Two-output lift node: normal Mountaintops route and Secret Medallion Snowfield route.

nodes.label: Zamor Ruins
nodes.description: First major grace after the normal Rold lift arrival.

nodes.label: Whiteridge Road
nodes.description: Branch point for Castle Sol and the Flame Peak approach.

nodes.label: Freezing Lake
nodes.description: Eastern Mountaintops landmark on the route toward the giant-chain and optional side areas.

nodes.label: Giants' Gravepost
nodes.description: Chain-bridge landmark before Foot of the Forge.

nodes.label: Foot of the Forge
nodes.description: Fire Giant approach grace.

nodes.label: Fire Giant
nodes.description: Main-story boss gate before the Forge of the Giants.

nodes.label: Forge of the Giants
nodes.description: Post-Fire Giant grace and world-transition landmark.

nodes.label: Castle Sol Main Gate
nodes.description: Castle Sol legacy-dungeon entry floor.

nodes.label: Church of the Eclipse
nodes.description: Intermediate Castle Sol interior floor before the rooftop boss approach.

nodes.label: Commander Niall
nodes.description: Boss gate protecting the Castle Sol rooftop route.

nodes.label: Castle Sol Rooftop
nodes.description: Post-Niall rooftop grace and Haligtree Secret Medallion landmark region.

nodes.description: Secret Medallion arrival layer with separate Mohgwyn and Ordina branches.

nodes.label: Inner Consecrated Snowfield
nodes.description: Intermediate snowfield layer before Ordina.

nodes.label: The First Step

nodes.label: Church of Elleh

nodes.label: Gatefront

nodes.label: Stormveil Cliffside

nodes.description: Interior chamber on the Godrick approach route.

nodes.description: Post-Red-Wolf Academy grace before Rennala.

nodes.description: Post-Rennala Academy grace.

edges.note: 从大道旁露台沿巨龙石翼向高处路线前进。
经王城高处路线进入黄金树大教堂区域。
从黄金树大教堂退出并朝电梯方向下行。
乘坐大教堂西侧电梯到下层。
沿下层路线前进到巨矛上方栏杆。
从栏杆跳到下方小平台；不生成反向边。
沿巨龙石矛向上到达目标物品。

edges.mode: 树根上行 / 外部路线
edges.note: 从黄金树大教堂沿树根和外部高处路线到女王闺阁。
女王闺阁之后到达王座前 Boss 区域；此边只表示到达 Boss 门。

edges.mode: 击败蒙葛特后激活赐福
edges.note: Boss 房与赐福是两个节点；未击败蒙葛特时不能把艾尔登王座当作已激活终点。
从井底赐福向希芙拉河远端电梯前进；目录资料不提供原始坐标。
电梯把玩家从井底路线带到希芙拉河主河道赐福；不生成反向边。
从兽墓深处沿法姆·亚兹拉废墟和楼层连接向龙教堂接近。

edges.mode: 神皮双人组 Boss 后赐福
edges.note: 龙教堂祭坛作为 Boss 后状态节点；未击败神皮双人组时不把它当作已开放路线终点。
城前镇是 Castle Ensis 的主要外部入口，先到检查站赐福。
经过城内路线和电梯到达城主房间赐福。
城主房间赐福位于蕾拉娜 Boss 雾门前。
击败 Castle Ensis 主 Boss 后才能激活恩希斯赏月地赐福。
Ranni 线解锁传送门后，单向抵达安瑟尔河主流；不生成反向步行边。
击败碎星拉塔恩后星陨形成入口；未满足状态时不把诺克隆连入地表。
点亮四座雕像后开放圣树传送门。
传送到圣树树冠；不生成从树冠返回仪典镇的普通通行边。

edges.mode: 树冠下降 / 圣树城入口
edges.note: 从树冠沿枝干和建筑路线下降到圣树骑士罗蕾塔 Boss 门。

edges.mode: 击败圣树骑士罗蕾塔后开放
edges.note: Boss 前门与 Boss 后赐福分离。

edges.mode: 官邸隐藏路线 / 监牢城镇
edges.note: 从火山官邸内部进入监牢城镇；这是独立地图内部路线，不是地表直线边。
沿监牢城镇和屋顶路线抵达神皮贵族 Boss 门。
击败神皮贵族后激活 Temple of Eiglay 赐福。
Ainsel River Main continues into the Nokstella city section; no surface shortcut is implied.
The basin is a lower floor of the Nokstella route, not a nearby surface marker.
Conservative Ranni-state gate for the descent after the Baleful Shadow section.
Represents the hazardous crossing and route landmarks; it is not an Euclidean straight-line edge.
The coffin is modeled as a one-way plane transition into the Astel encounter area.
The post-boss exit is state-gated; the route does not assume the arena can be bypassed.
The Aqueduct boss gate must be cleared before the coffin transition is considered reachable.
The arrival remains on the underground Deeproot layer.
Represents the root-and-ledge route to the upper Deeproot landmark.
Normal Rold Medallion output; the Secret Medallion output is modeled separately.
Forward west-to-north route through the first Mountaintops section.
Eastern Mountaintops branch; not a shortcut into Castle Sol's interior.
Connects the eastern landmark back to the Flame Peak approach layer.
Branches into a separate Castle Sol legacy layer.
Formal floor transition inside Castle Sol.
Approach node before Commander Niall.
Post-boss Castle Sol rooftop state.
The Flame Peak chain route before the Fire Giant arena.
Boss gate from the named approach grace.
Post-boss Forge of the Giants grace; no free jump from Foot of the Forge is implied.
Alternate Grand Lift output; modeled independently from the normal Mountaintops output.
Formal split between the southern and inner snowfield layers.
Ordina is the final snowfield landmark before its separate puzzle and Haligtree sending gate.
A physical approach to the portal; the actual cross-plane jump is a separate edge.
One-way output from the western Snowfield portal.
Direct item teleport to the mausoleum entrance; no physical Snowfield path is implied.
The portal arrival and mausoleum entrance are distinct nodes.
Interior route toward the midpoint elevator.
The elevator is retained as a transition type rather than collapsed into a flat walk edge.
Post-boss Cocoon grace state.
Opening surface route.
Road route toward Stormhill.
Surface approach to the Stormveil gate.
Normal legacy-dungeon entry after the Margit gate.
Castle entry to the cliffside floor.
Outer-wall climb to Rampart Tower.
Interior transition to the lift-side chamber.
Main castle route before the final boss gate.
Named grace to boss gate.
North exit into Liurnia is kept behind Godrick.

Academy gate to first interior grace.
Distinct vertical Academy route.
Academy interior boss gate.
Post-Red-Wolf Debate Parlor state.
Debate Parlor to Grand Library boss gate.
Post-boss Academy grace.
Surface branch; it does not require clearing Raya Lucaria.
Two-piece key-item lift transition.
Lift arrival to main Altus junction.
Outer Wall Phantom Tree approach.
Outskirts route before the capital gate.
Capital gate boss node.
Post-gate capital arrival.

coverage.scope: P0 plus representative slices across underground, legacy dungeons and Shadow Realm
